title: Ramesh Ramaswamy – Director of Digital Engineering
description: Meet Ramesh Ramaswamy, Director of Digital Engineering at Ameratech.ai, driving advanced AI, cloud, and digital transformation solutions for enterprises.
body:
# Ramesh Ramaswamy

Director of Digital Engineering

Ramesh Ramaswamy has over 30 Plus Years of Experience in IT transformation, business growth, and client management. Proven track record in driving revenue, leading high-impact programs, and optimizing operational efficiency. Adept at building and scaling service lines, developing go-to-market strategies, and mentoring teams for long-term business sustainability. Passionate about fostering innovation and delivering measurable business outcomes.
